slok.be:
সত্কারমানপূজার্থং তপো দম্ভেন চৈব যত্ |
ক্রিযতে তদিহ প্রোক্তং রাজসং চলমধ্রুবম্ ||১৭-১৮||
slok.en:
satkāramānapūjārthaṃ tapo dambhena caiva yat .
kriyate tadiha proktaṃ rājasaṃ calamadhruvam ||17-18||
slok.hi:
सत्कारमानपूजार्थं तपो दम्भेन चैव यत् |
क्रियते तदिह प्रोक्तं राजसं चलमध्रुवम् ||१७-१८||
slok.ka:
ಸತ್ಕಾರಮಾನಪೂಜಾರ್ಥಂ ತಪೋ ದಮ್ಭೇನ ಚೈವ ಯತ್ |
ಕ್ರಿಯತೇ ತದಿಹ ಪ್ರೋಕ್ತಂ ರಾಜಸಂ ಚಲಮಧ್ರುವಮ್ ||೧೭-೧೮||

verse_translation.life_application: Avoid performing good deeds or self-discipline merely to gain praise, public honor, or showy status.

commentary.text: 17.18 The austerity which is practiced for the sake of welcome, honor, and worship, and with hypocrisy, is here said to be Rajasic, unstable, and transitory.

slok.be:
দাতব্যমিতি যদ্দানং দীযতেঽনুপকারিণে |
দেশে কালে চ পাত্রে চ তদ্দানং সাত্ত্বিকং স্মৃতম্ ||১৭-২০||
slok.en:
dātavyamiti yaddānaṃ dīyate.anupakāriṇe .
deśe kāle ca pātre ca taddānaṃ sāttvikaṃ smṛtam ||17-20||
slok.hi:
दातव्यमिति यद्दानं दीयतेऽनुपकारिणे |
देशे काले च पात्रे च तद्दानं सात्त्विकं स्मृतम् ||१७-२०||
slok.ka:
ದಾತವ್ಯಮಿತಿ ಯದ್ದಾನಂ ದೀಯತೇಽನುಪಕಾರಿಣೇ |
ದೇಶೇ ಕಾಲೇ ಚ ಪಾತ್ರೇ ಚ ತದ್ದಾನಂ ಸಾತ್ತ್ವಿಕಂ ಸ್ಮೃತಮ್ ||೧೭-೨೦||

verse_translation.life_application: Charity given to worthy person, at right place and time, expecting nothing in return, 'duty to give'—is Sattvic.

commentary.text: 17.20 That gift which is given to one who does nothing in return, with the idea that 'it is a duty to give', in a fit place and time to a worthy person, is considered Sattvic.

slok.be:
সত্ত্বং সুখে সঞ্জযতি রজঃ কর্মণি ভারত |
জ্ঞানমাবৃত্য তু তমঃ প্রমাদে সঞ্জযত্যুত ||১৪-৯||
slok.en:
sattvaṃ sukhe sañjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhārata .
jñānamāvṛtya tu tamaḥ pramāde sañjayatyuta ||14-9||
slok.hi:
सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत |
ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे सञ्जयत्युत ||१४-९||
slok.ka:
ಸತ್ತ್ವಂ ಸುಖೇ ಸಞ್ಜಯತಿ ರಜಃ ಕರ್ಮಣಿ ಭಾರತ |
ಜ್ಞಾನಮಾವೃತ್ಯ ತು ತಮಃ ಪ್ರಮಾದೇ ಸಞ್ಜಯತ್ಯುತ ||೧೪-೯||

verse_translation.life_application: Goodness attaches to happiness, passion to action, while ignorance, veiling wisdom, attaches to heedlessness.

commentary.text: 14.9 O descendant of Bharata! Sattva-guna attaches one to happiness and Rajo-guna to action, but Tamo-guna, veiling knowledge, attaches the soul to negligence.

slok.be:
যত্রোপরমতে চিত্তং নিরুদ্ধং যোগসেবযা |
যত্র চৈবাত্মনাত্মানং পশ্যন্নাত্মনি তুষ্যতি ||৬-২০||
slok.en:
yatroparamate cittaṃ niruddhaṃ yogasevayā .
yatra caivātmanātmānaṃ paśyannātmani tuṣyati ||6-20||
slok.hi:
यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवया |
यत्र चैवात्मनात्मानं पश्यन्नात्मनि तुष्यति ||६-२०||
slok.ka:
ಯತ್ರೋಪರಮತೇ ಚಿತ್ತಂ ನಿರುದ್ಧಂ ಯೋಗಸೇವಯಾ |
ಯತ್ರ ಚೈವಾತ್ಮನಾತ್ಮಾನಂ ಪಶ್ಯನ್ನಾತ್ಮನಿ ತುಷ್ಯತಿ ||೬-೨೦||

verse_translation.life_application: Experience the quiet joy of a quieted mind where thought ceases and you behold your true inner self.

commentary.text: 6.20 When the mind, restrained by the practice of Yoga, attains quietude, and when seeing the Self by the self, one is satisfied in the Self—

slok.be:
সুখং ত্বিদানীং ত্রিবিধং শৃণু মে ভরতর্ষভ |
অভ্যাসাদ্রমতে যত্র দুঃখান্তং চ নিগচ্ছতি ||১৮-৩৬||
slok.en:
sukhaṃ tvidānīṃ trividhaṃ śṛṇu me bharatarṣabha .
abhyāsādramate yatra duḥkhāntaṃ ca nigacchati ||18-36||
slok.hi:
सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं शृणु मे भरतर्षभ |
अभ्यासाद्रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छति ||१८-३६||
slok.ka:
ಸುಖಂ ತ್ವಿದಾನೀಂ ತ್ರಿವಿಧಂ ಶೃಣು ಮೇ ಭರತರ್ಷಭ |
ಅಭ್ಯಾಸಾದ್ರಮತೇ ಯತ್ರ ದುಃಖಾನ್ತಂ ಚ ನಿಗಚ್ಛತಿ ||೧೮-೩೬||

verse_translation.life_application: Hear now of threefold happiness, in which one rejoices by practice and reaches end of pain.

commentary.text: 18.36 O best of the Bharatas, now hear from Me of the three kinds of happiness, in which one rejoices by practice and attains the end of all sorrow.

slok.be:
বহিরন্তশ্চ ভূতানামচরং চরমেব চ |
সূক্ষ্মত্বাত্তদবিজ্ঞেযং দূরস্থং চান্তিকে চ তত্ ||১৩-১৬||
slok.en:
bahirantaśca bhūtānāmacaraṃ carameva ca .
sūkṣmatvāttadavijñeyaṃ dūrasthaṃ cāntike ca tat ||13-16||
slok.hi:
बहिरन्तश्च भूतानामचरं चरमेव च |
सूक्ष्मत्वात्तदविज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च तत् ||१३-१६||
slok.ka:
ಬಹಿರನ್ತಶ್ಚ ಭೂತಾನಾಮಚರಂ ಚರಮೇವ ಚ |
ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮತ್ವಾತ್ತದವಿಜ್ಞೇಯಂ ದೂರಸ್ಥಂ ಚಾನ್ತಿಕೇ ಚ ತತ್ ||೧೩-೧೬||

verse_translation.life_application: Know the Divine as undivided yet standing as if divided in beings, the sustainer, devourer, and generator of all.

commentary.text: 13.16 That Brahman exists without and within all beings; It is moving and also unmoving. Because of Its subtlety, It is incomprehensible; It is far away and yet very near.

slok.be:
শুক্লকৃষ্ণে গতী হ্যেতে জগতঃ শাশ্বতে মতে |
একযা যাত্যনাবৃত্তিমন্যযাবর্ততে পুনঃ ||৮-২৬||
slok.en:
śuklakṛṣṇe gatī hyete jagataḥ śāśvate mate .
ekayā yātyanāvṛttimanyayāvartate punaḥ ||8-26||
slok.hi:
शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते |
एकया यात्यनावृत्तिमन्ययावर्तते पुनः ||८-२६||
slok.ka:
ಶುಕ್ಲಕೃಷ್ಣೇ ಗತೀ ಹ್ಯೇತೇ ಜಗತಃ ಶಾಶ್ವತೇ ಮತೇ |
ಏಕಯಾ ಯಾತ್ಯನಾವೃತ್ತಿಮನ್ಯಯಾವರ್ತತೇ ಪುನಃ ||೮-೨೬||

verse_translation.life_application: Know these two eternal paths of light and darkness, one leading to liberation and the other to rebirth.

commentary.text: 8.26 Truly these two paths, the bright and the dark, are considered eternal for the world; by the one man goes to non-return, and by the other he returns again.

slok.be:
এবং বহুবিধা যজ্ঞা বিততা ব্রহ্মণো মুখে |
কর্মজান্বিদ্ধি তান্সর্বানেবং জ্ঞাত্বা বিমোক্ষ্যসে ||৪-৩২||
slok.en:
evaṃ bahuvidhā yajñā vitatā brahmaṇo mukhe .
karmajānviddhi tānsarvānevaṃ jñātvā vimokṣyase ||4-32||
slok.hi:
एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे |
कर्मजान्विद्धि तान्सर्वानेवं ज्ञात्वा विमोक्ष्यसे ||४-३२||
slok.ka:
ಏವಂ ಬಹುವಿಧಾ ಯಜ್ಞಾ ವಿತತಾ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಣೋ ಮುಖೇ |
ಕರ್ಮಜಾನ್ವಿದ್ಧಿ ತಾನ್ಸರ್ವಾನೇವಂ ಜ್ಞಾತ್ವಾ ವಿಮೋಕ್ಷ್ಯಸೇ ||೪-೩೨||

verse_translation.life_application: Understand that all constructive human actions can serve as spiritual practices when performed with noble intent.

commentary.text: 4.32 Thus manifold sacrifices are spread out before Brahman. Know them all as born of action; knowing this, thou shalt be liberated.

slok.be:
তদিত্যনভিসন্ধায ফলং যজ্ঞতপঃক্রিযাঃ |
দানক্রিযাশ্চ বিবিধাঃ ক্রিযন্তে মোক্ষকাঙ্ক্ষিভিঃ ||১৭-২৫||
slok.en:
tadityanabhisandhāya phalaṃ yajñatapaḥkriyāḥ .
dānakriyāśca vividhāḥ kriyante mokṣakāṅkṣibhiḥ ||17-25||
slok.hi:
तदित्यनभिसन्धाय फलं यज्ञतपःक्रियाः |
दानक्रियाश्च विविधाः क्रियन्ते मोक्षकाङ्क्षिभिः ||१७-२५||
slok.ka:
ತದಿತ್ಯನಭಿಸನ್ಧಾಯ ಫಲಂ ಯಜ್ಞತಪಃಕ್ರಿಯಾಃ |
ದಾನಕ್ರಿಯಾಶ್ಚ ವಿವಿಧಾಃ ಕ್ರಿಯನ್ತೇ ಮೋಕ್ಷಕಾಙ್ಕ್ಷಿಭಿಃ ||೧೭-೨೫||

verse_translation.life_application: Uttering 'Tat' without seeking fruit, acts of sacrifice, austerity, and gift are performed by seekers of liberation.

commentary.text: 17.25 Pronouncing 'TAT' (meaning That), without seeking the fruits of actions, the seekers of liberation perform various acts of sacrifice, austerity, and charity.

slok.be:
তত্র সত্ত্বং নির্মলত্বাত্প্রকাশকমনামযম্ |
সুখসঙ্গেন বধ্নাতি জ্ঞানসঙ্গেন চানঘ ||১৪-৬||
slok.en:
tatra sattvaṃ nirmalatvātprakāśakamanāmayam .
sukhasaṅgena badhnāti jñānasaṅgena cānagha ||14-6||
slok.hi:
तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम् |
सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ ||१४-६||
slok.ka:
ತತ್ರ ಸತ್ತ್ವಂ ನಿರ್ಮಲತ್ವಾತ್ಪ್ರಕಾಶಕಮನಾಮಯಮ್ |
ಸುಖಸಙ್ಗೇನ ಬಧ್ನಾತಿ ಜ್ಞಾನಸಙ್ಗೇನ ಚಾನಘ ||೧೪-೬||

verse_translation.life_application: Understand goodness as luminous and healthy, yet binding the soul through attachment to happiness and knowledge.

commentary.text: 14.6 O sinless Arjuna! Of these (three), Sattvaguna, being pure, is illuminating and flawless (healthy and untroubled); it binds (the jiva) through attachment to happiness and attachment to knowledge.
